summary.content:
Today's selection covers 61 articles from 7 trusted sources, including 43 on Artificial Intelligence and 10 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: AI firm Anthropic seeks weapons expert to stop users from 'misuse'
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: LeakNet ransomware uses ClickFix and Deno runtime for stealthy attacks
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BleepingComputer, BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, SecurityWeek, The Verge and others
• **Fresh Content**: 45 articles published in the last 24 hours
